control_name: Privileged access is logged and independently reviewed
control_objective: All privileged accounts on financially-significant systems are inventoried, their actions are captured in the SIEM, and each account is independently reviewed each quarter so that elevated access cannot be misused without detection.
risk_addressed: Unmonitored privileged access permits administrators to alter data, configurations, or controls outside the normal transaction path, enabling undetected fraud or error that misstates the financial statements.

required_data_sources.system_of_record: Microsoft Entra ID Privileged Identity Management

required_data_elements.business_definition: An account holding an elevated/administrative role on an in-scope system.
The independent reviewer's recorded decision on each privileged account.
A logged action performed under a privileged account, captured in the SIEM.

method.summary: Reconcile the privileged account inventory to independent review decisions and to SIEM activity logging, confirming full review coverage and full action capture.
steps: Pull the inventory of privileged accounts for in-scope systems from Entra ID PIM.
Pull the independent review decisions and compute the percentage of accounts reviewed.
Count privileged accounts with no recorded independent review (unreviewed).
Reconcile privileged accounts to the SIEM and compute the percentage of privileged actions logged.
Flag any account not reviewed or any privileged action not captured in the SIEM.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any privileged account left unreviewed, or privileged activity not logged, is a control exception.

pass_criteria: Every privileged account was independently reviewed.
All privileged actions captured in the SIEM.
fail_criteria: One or more privileged accounts were not reviewed.
exception_handling: Complete the missing reviews and remediate logging gaps before relying on the control.

assertions.description: All privileged actions captured in the SIEM.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify IT Security Manager and CISO
